warning.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery Sport eD4 Injector Seal Leaks & EGR Clogging
paragraphs: If your Discovery Sport eD4 is a pre-2019 model with the Ford Duratorq diesel — that's the L550 generation — injector seal leaks and EGR clogging are a well-documented pattern on this engine, established through Ford/Land Rover specialist consensus. We replace injector seals, the EGR valve, and the timing belt as standard on every Ford Duratorq rebuild.

The later Discovery Sport diesel range (2019–present) uses the Ingenium family of engines, which are different units entirely — D150/D180/D240, then D165/D200 — and don't share the Ford Duratorq pattern documented here.
warning.source: Source: established Ford/Land Rover specialist pattern, per VRF-landrover-discovery-sport.md. Applies to Duratorq-fitted pre-2016 models only; Ingenium diesel variants are separate and not covered by this specific claim
